guidance: Evaluate the latest answer against the current question and objective, not future stages.
Required criteria are semantic outcomes. Concepts are examples and alternatives, not an AND checklist or mandatory products.
Accept a justified algorithm, database or vendor; probe claims actually made rather than demanding every alternative.
Do not penalize optional features, omitted diagram boxes, company-specific facts or small rounding differences.
Use the fictional workload consistently; accept an explicitly justified alternative workload and its arithmetic.
Weights and minimumCoverage are advisory; runtime progression uses required criteria and report scores are computed in code.

scoreAnchors.description: Does not address the current question or makes a fundamental correctness error.
Names plausible components but cannot explain their mechanism or limitations.
Explains a workable baseline with some gaps in the current objective.
Explains a coherent mechanism, failure cases and justified tradeoffs.
Quantifies and defends a robust design, recognizing limits and alternatives.

topics.name: Requirements
topics.guidance: Agree on product behavior, measurable quality targets and the stated exercise workload. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Functional scope
concepts.guidance: Clarify online/offline delivery, group bounds, media references and acknowledgement meanings; typing indicators are optional.

concepts.name: Core operations and users
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Functional scope. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Quality targets
concepts.guidance: Separate accepted, delivered and read states; order within a conversation rather than globally.

concepts.name: Latency and availability targets
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Quality targets. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Capacity estimates
concepts.guidance: Use the fictional baseline or state a justified alternative; derive average and peak rates and distinguish payload bytes from replication and indexes.

concepts.name: Daily volume divided by 86400
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Capacity estimates. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: High Level Design
topics.guidance: Separate connection routing, durable messaging and asynchronous notifications. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Connection routing
concepts.guidance: Route authenticated persistent connections to a connection server; WebSocket or an equivalent transport is acceptable.

concepts.name: Persistent connections
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Connection routing. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Durable messaging
concepts.guidance: Assign message persistence and recipient delivery to a messaging service and durable store.

concepts.name: Message service
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Durable messaging. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Offline and media paths
concepts.guidance: Describe offline backlog access and media stored outside the message database.

concepts.name: Offline backlog
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Offline and media paths. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Core Flow
topics.guidance: Provide practical at-least-once delivery with deduplication and bounded ordering. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Acknowledgement boundary
concepts.guidance: Distinguish server acceptance from recipient delivery and read receipts; persist before acceptance ACK.

concepts.name: Durable acceptance ACK
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Acknowledgement boundary. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Retry deduplication
concepts.guidance: Use a stable client message ID so reconnect retries do not create duplicate visible messages.

concepts.name: Client-generated message ID
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Retry deduplication. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Conversation ordering
concepts.guidance: Choose per-conversation sequence allocation or a justified alternative; handle gaps and duplicate arrivals.

concepts.name: Per-conversation sequence
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Conversation ordering. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Group fanout
concepts.guidance: Explain bounded group membership lookup and per-recipient delivery without promising a global order across chats.

concepts.name: Group membership version
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Group fanout. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Data Model
topics.guidance: Model conversations, membership and messages with cursor-based reads. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Message schema
concepts.guidance: Key messages by conversation and sequence or equivalent sortable cursor; store sender, stable message ID and payload reference.

concepts.name: conversation_id and sequence
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Message schema. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.guidance: Represent group membership and per-device delivered/read cursors while enforcing access.

concepts.name: Conversation membership
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Membership and cursors. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Retention and pagination
concepts.guidance: Use cursor pagination and an explicit retention policy; do not retain media inline in text rows.

concepts.name: Cursor pagination
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Retention and pagination. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Reliability
topics.guidance: Recover delivery from durable state rather than transient Pub/Sub. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Durable replay
concepts.guidance: A transient Redis Pub/Sub channel alone is not an offline message store; replay from durable messages or a durable log.

concepts.name: Durable replay log

concepts.name: Safe notifications
concepts.guidance: Push notifications are hints, not proof of delivery; respect membership changes and avoid leaking private media.

concepts.name: Push as a delivery hint
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Safe notifications. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

topics.name: Scaling
topics.guidance: Scale connections, writes and fanout independently. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Partitioning
concepts.guidance: Choose conversation-based ownership for message order; distribute unrelated conversations independently.

concepts.name: Conversation partition
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Partitioning. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.
